title: Issue #4199 daemon authority test determinism
intent: PR #4201 is Ready with all 19 CI checks green; awaiting merge
progress_summary: Root-caused, fixed, verified, and handed off as PR #4201 (Ready). The Issue premise was wrong: no develop regression. Both reported panics reproduce byte-identically on unmodified develop HEAD in a Linux container by starving only the 250 ms ISSUE_MONITOR_PREFS_TIMEOUT budget (server.rs:13288 !recovery_blocked at 1ms; server.rs:13129 Err(Rejected) vs Err(RecoveryBlocked) at 2ms). The Rejected shape came from the fixture silently losing its overlapping-authority premise: a budget expiry with a missing fence returns recovery_blocked:false with authority_retry_pending and no lease, so the worker took authority itself, reached the decoder, and rejected the deliberately malformed frame. Commit 781181302 made that shape reachable but is itself correct. Contract answer: RecoveryBlocked is right and no production branch changed - the two states are unreachable from the same worker. Fix pins the hang-guard budget in both tests, asserts the lease premise, and adds authority_owning_worker_rejects_a_malformed_control to pin the discriminator. GREEN: 3 tests pass 5/5 in 0.10s under the same starvation. CI is the verification of record (cfg(unix) surface, Windows derived matrix unsatisfiable per #4182): all 19 checks SUCCESS/SKIPPED, record vrr-c025783c228a46fc94d25aea5f476bf7. Two follow-ups reported out of scope: terminal recovery-blocked on budget expiry against a retained fence, and client_status_request_returns_daemon_snapshot plus the shared-project-dir overlap the new test also tripped over.
